description: rhize-devflow — this plugin auto-wires no hooks. The conditional SessionStart banner (dev-file signals -> command menu) moved to rhize-context-manager/hooks/session-disclosure.js (2026-08-09, Phase 3 banner consolidation) — stack detection there covers the same signal via the skill map's stack tags. Heavier guard hooks (prewrite mutation check, rca-enforcer, regression-guard, protect-files) ship bundled under this directory and inside each skill but remain OPT-IN: wire them into your project's .claude/settings.json when you want them. The context-engineering and skill-refinement hooks moved to rhize-context-manager — see CHANGELOG 2026-08-09.
